C0964.title: Machine Learning-Driven Attacks Against Anti-Phishing Blacklists
C0964.summary: The study, indexed in December 2024, analyzes machine-learning-assisted evasion of anti-phishing blacklists and discusses limits in blacklist coverage and detection latency. It presents feature-driven and TLS-based cloaking attacks that can help phishing sites evade detection without breaking the page's visual appearance.
